ambient_events: Somebody comes off a cot, laces up, takes a sheet off the board and is gone without a word to anyone.
The board reads a column of times and a column of chalk symbols. No place names anywhere on it.
A pair of boots by the door has been resoled so many times there's almost nothing original left.
description: Six cots, six lockers, and a chalked board of legs. The Watch move their messages on foot, and no runner is ever told more than one leg of a route. You take a sealed sheet from a face you know to a face you know, and you aren't told what's on it or where it goes next. Half of them are asleep at any hour. The board never carries a destination, only a time and a shape.
name: The Runners' Den
